items_flat.title_en: Anthropic commits 5% of shares to new Public Benefit Fund that can grow with valuation
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 將5%股份投入可隨估值成長的新公益基金
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced it is committing a portion of its shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a wholly owned LLC. Subject to stockholder approval, 5% of shares are committed immediately, with an additional 2% possible at board discretion for every 50% valuation increase above a baseline. Combined with prior co-founder and employee pledges, roughly 20% of shares are dedicated to public purposes, with none used for lobbying.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic宣布將部分股份投入Anthropic Public Benefit Fund，該基金為全資擁有的有限責任公司。在股東批准下，立即投入5%股份，每估值成長50%可再增加至多2%。加上共同創辦人與員工既有承諾，約20%股份將用於公益，且不會用於遊說。
items_flat.analysis_en: The structure ties a growing ownership stake to public benefit as Anthropic approaches a large IPO, offering a concrete mechanism beyond one-time pledges, though governance details and the baseline valuation remain to be disclosed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此結構將隨公司成長而擴大的股權與公益綁定，在Anthropic籌備大型IPO之際提供具體機制，超越一次性承諾，但治理細節與基準估值仍待公布。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re committing a portion of Anthropic’s shares to the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new entity with a structure that increases the stake as the company grows. Subject to stockholder approval, 5% of Anthropic’s shares will be committed today, with an additional 2% added at the board’s discretion for every 50% increase in the company’s value above a set baseline.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們將Anthropic部分股份投入Anthropic Public Benefit Fund，這是一個隨公司成長而增加持股的新實體。在股東批准下，今天將投入5%股份，每公司價值較基準成長50%，董事會可酌情再增加2%。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI upgrades GPT-6 Pro in ChatGPT with parallel agents and collaborative Slides
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI為ChatGPT中的GPT-6 Pro升級平行代理與協作Slides
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced that GPT-6 Pro (also referenced as GPT-6 Astra Pro) in the Chat tab now delivers faster responses, better plugin and tool use, and support for multiple agents working on different parts of a task in parallel, with visible progress tracking and the ability to review completed work. The company also introduced ChatGPT Slides for collaborative presentation creation and editing with export options, rolling out to eligible Pro, Business, and Enterprise users.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布Chat標籤中的GPT-6 Pro（亦稱GPT-6 Astra Pro）現提供更快回應、更好外掛與工具使用，並支援多個代理平行處理任務不同部分，進度可見且可檢視完成工作。公司同時推出ChatGPT Slides，供協作建立與編輯簡報並可匯出，向符合資格的Pro、Business與Enterprise用戶推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: Parallel agents mark a concrete step from single-threaded chat toward multi-agent workflows inside the consumer product, though availability remains limited to higher-tier plans and real-world throughput gains are still being independently measured.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 平行代理標誌著消費端產品從單線對話邁向多代理工作流程的具體一步，但可用性仍限於較高方案，實際吞吐量提升仍待獨立驗證。
items_flat.quote: GPT-6 Astra Pro in ChatGPT got an upgrade with faster responses and improved use of plugins and tools. And now, multiple agents can tackle different parts of a task in parallel. You can follow each agent’s progress and open completed tasks to review their work. Now available to Pro users in the Chat tab.
items_flat.quote_zh: ChatGPT中的GPT-6 Astra Pro獲得升級，回應更快、外掛與工具使用更佳。現在多個代理可平行處理任務不同部分。您可追蹤各代理進度並開啟完成任務檢視其工作。現已向Chat標籤的Pro用戶提供。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic reports junior technical hiring drop and agents logging 6x human hours
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic報告初階技術招聘下降、代理工時達人類6倍
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic published internal research showing that the share of junior technical hires fell from 27% to 9% over roughly a year, while technical roles as a share of the workforce declined from 61% to 56%. By August 2026, employee-directed Claude agents logged six times the active work hours of human staff (19x in research teams), with agents first surpassing aggregate human hours in March.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic發布內部研究顯示，約一年內初階技術招聘占比從27%降至9%，技術職能占員工比例從61%降至56%。至2026年8月，員工導向的Claude代理活躍工時達人類的6倍（研究團隊19倍），代理總工時於3月首次超越人類。
items_flat.analysis_en: The data offers a rare inside view of how heavy agent adoption can reshape hiring and work composition at a frontier lab, though Anthropic notes its AI-native workflows may not fully generalize and agent hours include substantial idle time awaiting human input.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 數據提供前沿實驗室大量採用代理後如何重塑招聘與工作組成的罕見內部視角，但Anthropic指出其AI原生流程未必完全通用，且代理工時包含大量等待人類輸入的閒置時間。
items_flat.quote: By August, there were six times more agents than employees at Anthropic, and productivity increased.
items_flat.quote_zh: 到八月，Anthropic 的代理數量已是員工的六倍，生產力也隨之提升。

items_flat.title_en: DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash-1017 with stronger agent scores and open weights
items_flat.title_zh: DeepSeek發布V4.1-Flash-1017，代理分數更強且開源權重
items_flat.summary_en: DeepSeek shipped DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, a minor update to its previous Flash model that improves scores across agentic and coding benchmarks (including 77.0 on DeepSWE v1.1 versus 74.0 for Claude Opus 5 in the company’s table), finishes tasks faster with shorter outputs, and is available with MIT-licensed weights on Hugging Face at unchanged API pricing.
items_flat.summary_zh: DeepSeek推出DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017，為先前Flash模型的小幅更新，在代理與編碼基準上提升分數（公司表格中DeepSWE v1.1達77.0，對比Claude Opus 5的74.0），任務完成更快、輸出更短，並以MIT授權權重在Hugging Face提供，API價格不變。
items_flat.analysis_en: The update strengthens the cost-performance case for open-weight agentic models relative to closed frontier options on specific coding benchmarks, though independent verification of the claimed gains and real-world reliability remains limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此更新強化開源權重代理模型在特定編碼基準上相對閉源前沿選項的成本效益論述，但所宣稱提升的獨立驗證與真實世界可靠性仍有限。
items_flat.quote: Stronger benchmark performance, faster task completion, and shorter outputs than the previous version—a Pareto improvement in performance and cost.
items_flat.quote_zh: 比先前版本更強的基準表現、更快的任務完成與更短的輸出——在效能與成本上的帕累托改進。

items_flat.title_en: Meta removes controversial AI training language from updated commercial terms after backlash
items_flat.title_zh: Meta在反彈後從更新商用條款中移除爭議AI訓練語言
items_flat.summary_en: Meta updated its commercial terms and then removed language that critics said could allow the company to crawl business customers’ websites and use the content to train AI models. A Meta spokesperson stated the crawling provisions only applied to ads and business products, and the company clarified the terms accordingly while maintaining there was no substantive change to crawler behavior; the terms take effect October 30.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta更新商用條款後移除批評者認為可能允許公司爬取商業客戶網站並用於訓練AI模型的語言。Meta發言人表示爬取條款僅適用於廣告與商業產品，公司據此澄清條款，同時強調爬蟲行為無實質改變；條款將於10月30日生效。
items_flat.analysis_en: The rapid walk-back highlights ongoing sensitivity around web-crawling rights for AI training, especially for publishers, even as Meta maintains there was no substantive change in practice and robots.txt remains the stated control mechanism.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 迅速撤回凸顯AI訓練網頁爬取權利的持續敏感，尤其對出版商而言，即使Meta堅持實務上無實質改變，且robots.txt仍為其聲明的控制機制。
items_flat.quote: We’ve heard you and want to clarify: the crawling terms we consolidated only applied to our ads and business products, and we’ve clarified that in the terms themselves. It does not change how Meta uses web crawlers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們已聽到你們的聲音並想澄清：我們整合的爬取條款僅適用於廣告與商業產品，我們已在條款中澄清。這不改變Meta使用網頁爬蟲的方式。

items_flat.title_en: OpenCode reports breach exposing OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API keys for some users
items_flat.title_zh: OpenCode報告外洩事件，部分用戶的OpenAI、Anthropic與Google API金鑰可能曝光
items_flat.summary_en: OpenCode disclosed unauthorized access to a legacy system it was decommissioning, stating that third-party provider API keys (including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google) saved by about 1.4% of Console users may have been exposed in what it described as related to a large-scale distillation attack. The company said it emailed affected users and is working with the labs on remediation; some users reported unauthorized charges.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenCode揭露其正在退役的舊系統遭未授權存取，表示約1.4% Console用戶儲存的第三方供應商API金鑰（含OpenAI、Anthropic與Google）可能曝光，公司描述與大規模蒸餾攻擊有關。公司表示已電郵通知受影響用戶並與實驗室合作修復；部分用戶回報未授權扣款。
items_flat.analysis_en: The incident underscores the security risks of third-party tools that store frontier-lab API keys, with limited public detail so far on the full scope or confirmed misuse beyond initial user reports of unexpected spend.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 事件凸顯儲存前沿實驗室API金鑰的第三方工具安全風險，目前公開細節有限，確認誤用範圍仍待更多資訊，超出初期用戶回報的意外花費。
items_flat.quote: We had a security breach last night related to a large scale distillation attack that impacted 1.4% of OpenCode Console users. We have notified them all this morning via email... we are working with Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google to remediate.
items_flat.quote_zh: 昨晚發生與大規模蒸餾攻擊相關的安全外洩，影響1.4%的OpenCode Console用戶。我們今早已透過電郵通知所有受影響者……我們正與Anthropic、OpenAI與Google合作修復。

brief_en: Anthropic commits 5% of shares to a growing Public Benefit Fund and reports agents logging 6x human hours with junior tech hires falling to 9%. OpenAI adds parallel agents to GPT-6 Pro plus collaborative Slides. DeepSeek ships a faster open-weight Flash update; Meta walks back controversial crawl language; OpenCode discloses API key exposure.
brief_zh: Anthropic 將5%股份投入可隨估值成長的公益基金，並報告代理工時達人類6倍、初階技術招聘降至9%。OpenAI為GPT-6 Pro加入平行代理與協作Slides。DeepSeek推出更快開源Flash更新；Meta撤回爭議爬取條款；OpenCode揭露API金鑰外洩。
